title: M3.5: Slack outbound: render, deliver, rate limits
description:
Render bot replies with Slack mrkdwn limits, post in thread with chat.postMessage and per-message username and icon for the bot's name, honor 429 Retry-After with bounded retries, split long text, never post outside the originating channel and thread unless a gated send.

Acceptance criteria:
- Reply appears in the originating thread under the bot's name
- 429 handling retries with the header value and then records failure
- Long answers are split or linked with an in-app link

Gherkin: features/slack_outbound.feature

Depends on: M3.4, M1.4

Contract: the External channels contract (initiative description; draft docs/EXTERNAL_CHANNELS.draft.md).

Process: Gherkin first (AGENTS.md outside-in). Write the named feature, add it to features/cucumber-features.txt, implement steps in conversation/features-support/steps/, then production code. Vitest only for pure helpers. Both cucumber-js and vitest must pass. No emojis, no compatibility forks, tenant_id on every item, strangers get 404. Product PR into develop with sub-agent review.
